name_story.story: Othman can be understood through the Arabic form عُثْمَان, whose central sense is othman; uthman. Othman is Arabic عُثْمَان (ʿUthmān), a male given name borne by the third caliph.

faq.a: Othman is associated with the Arabic form عُثْمَان, whose core sense is othman; uthman.

faq.q: What is the origin of Othman?
faq.a: Othman is associated with Arabic. Othman is Arabic عُثْمَان (ʿUthmān), a male given name borne by the third caliph.
Yes — the underlying form عُثْمَان is Arabic.
Othman can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Othman should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿUthmān is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Othman mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Othman is rendered عثمان and carries the sense عثمان، نبی کا صحابی.

faq.q: What does Othman mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Othman is rendered عثمان and carries the sense عثمان، صحابه پیامبر.
A romanized syllable approximation is ot-hman. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Othman?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Othman, othman. Script forms are عثمان, عُثْمَان, उस्मान.

faq.q: Is Othman a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
